subject.title: Weekly pace calculation ignores "Work days" setting for the Codex provider

question: When Codex historical data is available, should an explicit 4-, 5-, or 7-day Work days selection override the learned historical pace curve?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally preserves historical authority, but the setting appears authoritative to users and the linked pull request changes that established precedence; source inspection cannot determine the desired product semantics.

options.title: Explicit Schedule Wins
options.body: Use historical pace only in Automatic mode and make explicit 4/5/7-day selections authoritative while continuing to collect history.

options.title: Historical Pace Wins
options.body: Preserve current historical precedence and revise settings copy so users understand that Work days affects only standard fallback pacing and markers.

options.title: Add Separate Controls
options.body: Keep Work days for the schedule and add a distinct setting controlling whether historical predictions may override it, at the cost of more settings complexity.

recommendation.title: Explicit Schedule Wins
recommendation.body: Use historical pace only in Automatic mode and make explicit 4/5/7-day selections authoritative while continuing to collect history.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and approved the immediately preceding work-day pace semantics and are best positioned to decide whether historical authority should now change.
